focus: Gate 5 path and rule corpus map; prior work (022, 010)

statement: Gate 5 fires on the first write of a session only; read-only turns never fire it.
The router matches on the action about to be taken, never the prompt topic; a fire with no row phrase is a silent non-load.
Corpus is 13 rule files with 8 trigger_phrases each; the phrases name dispositions and anti-patterns, not tool actions.
A static second load path already exists where Gate 5 cannot reach: AGENTS.md:261 names five reply-time rules because Gate 5 never reaches replies.
The trigger index deliberately excludes .skilled/repo-rules; the documented reason is that indexing them would surface a rule as a context candidate.
022's admission bar refuses prompt-time injections that restate a disposition the always-loaded document already carries; only a prohibition a gate enforces earns a slot.
022's measurement lesson: event frequency must be read from the log, never reasoned about (gate advisory fires ~8/min at peak).
The advisor brief fires every user prompt; the constant directive is deduped via directive-lifecycle.ts; only the hygiene directive survives because a pre-commit gate enforces it.

Federation: canonical corpus .skilled/repo-rules (13 files); Public/repo-rules is a 13-symlink compatibility layer; Obsidian Plugin holds 12 of 13 symlinked plus 3 local rules; answer-the-actual-request.md never propagated.
evidence: directory listings: Public/.skilled/repo-rules, Public/repo-rules, Obsidian Plugin/repo-rules

statement: 010's governing constraint: content that must bind while reading cannot live in a rule file because Gate 5 fires only on writes; the rule set should not grow.
